rows.grounds: compound of śaṅkhinī and yukta, describing association
compound of meṣa and īśa, naming the presiding figure
compound of tarjanī and yuta, describing association

items.question: Which attendant figures accompany the lord of Meṣa in this enumeration?
premises: The lord of Meṣa is named as the subject.
The lord of Meṣa is joined with Śaṅkhinī.
The lord of Meṣa is accompanied by Tarjanī.
items.inference: The lord of Meṣa is identified together with Śaṅkhinī and Tarjanī as his associated figures.
uncertainties: The specific identities or roles of Śaṅkhinī and Tarjanī are not defined within this verse.
items.plain_english: The lord of Meṣa is joined with Śaṅkhinī and accompanied by Tarjanī.
